text: London is an incredible city to live in and a mediocre one to visit. The tourist circuit is worse than a dozen European capitals at half the cost.
label: hot_take

text: The Shinkansen from Tokyo to Osaka is 2h15 with a reserved seat on the Nozomi. Flying the same route, including transit to Narita, is about 3h45. Train is faster every time and costs about ¥13,000 versus ¥8,000 for the cheapest flight.
label: analysis

text: First day in Seoul and the subway is so well-signed that I made 4 transfers without any anxiety and I am a person who usually has subway anxiety.
label: reaction

text: Hostels are the correct choice for solo travelers under 35 and the wrong choice above 40. The age threshold is lower than people want to admit.
label: hot_take

text: Just watched a sunset from the rooftop in Santorini. I understand now why people cry here. I also understand why it was worth the logistical nightmare of getting to this island.
label: reaction

text: Just got back from three weeks in Colombia and I need to talk to someone who has also been there. Nobody at home understands why it got to me the way it did.
label: reaction

text: I have been to Chefchaouen and I need everyone to know that yes it really is that blue and yes it is worth going specifically to see a blue city.
label: reaction

text: Just got off a night train in Vienna. It is 6am. The city is quiet and cold. I have nowhere to be until noon. This is the part of travel people do not talk about enough.
label: reaction

text: Cruises are the most efficient way to travel if you accept that you are not really visiting anywhere—you are watching ports from a distance and calling it travel.
label: hot_take

text: First day in Budapest and I found a thermal bath by accident by following steam rising from a building. Fell asleep in a pool like I have been coming here for years.
label: reaction

text: Visited Patagonia in March vs November, same itinerary. March: 18°C average, 4 rainy days, 30% fewer people on the W Trek than November. Accommodation 20% cheaper, flights 15% cheaper.
label: analysis

text: Tracked baggage fee costs across 12 European low-cost carriers. Ryanair averages €32 per bag, Wizz Air €28, EasyJet €33. These fees now add 40-60% to the base ticket price for a typical weekend trip.
label: analysis

text: Checked the 2025 Lonely Planet top 10 against their 2020 list. 6 of 10 cities appeared in both. The 4 new entries were all smaller cities and all had dramatically cheaper accommodation than the repeats.
label: analysis

text: Compared taxi apps in Bangkok: Grab, Bolt, and InDrive. Over 20 rides, Grab averaged 180 THB, Bolt 165 THB, InDrive 140 THB. InDrive lets you negotiate the fare, which explains the lower average.
label: analysis

text: First morning in Beirut and the city already feels complicated in the way that only places with real history can feel complicated.
label: reaction

text: Southeast Asia backpacker culture peaked around 2010. The Banana Pancake Trail is now a middle-class package tour with different branding.
label: hot_take

text: Looked at Airbnb vs hostel prices in Barcelona for September. A private room in a central hostel averaged €68/night; comparable Airbnbs ran €95-120. The hostel wins unless you need a kitchen.
label: analysis

text: Any country that makes you think about your personal safety more than twice before arriving is telling you something worth listening to.
label: hot_take

text: The Maldives all-inclusive resort experience is just an expensive way to go to the beach without leaving your hotel. Might as well stay home and look at pictures.
label: hot_take

text: Just got back from 2 months in South America and my first thought when I got home was that the vegetables here are worse.
label: reaction

text: The Prague vs Budapest debate is settled: Budapest. It is cheaper, the food is better, the thermal baths are real, and the Instagram photos of Prague have nothing to do with the actual city.
label: hot_take

text: The Instagram-famous viewpoints are the worst places to experience any destination. They are crowded, staged, and represent nothing about where you actually are.
label: hot_take

text: Compared a 10-day Morocco itinerary done independently vs guided tour. Independent: $780 total. Guided tour: $2,100. The tour covered identical sites.
label: analysis

text: Checked correlation between Booking.com and TripAdvisor scores for 25 hotels I have stayed at. The platforms disagreed by more than 0.5 points on 9 of 25. Neither is consistently more accurate.
label: analysis

text: A two-week trip is too short for anywhere genuinely interesting. You are just scratching the surface and going home thinking you have been somewhere.
label: hot_take

text: Cuba is not worth the logistical difficulty unless you are specifically interested in 1950s cars and live music. Everything else is more available elsewhere.
label: hot_take

text: Measured walking distances between major attractions in Kyoto using Google Maps. Fushimi Inari to Nishiki Market is 8.2km on foot. A city bus covers it in 35 minutes and costs ¥230. Most visitors walk it and spend 2 hours getting lost.
label: analysis

text: Just completed the Inca Trail. Sat down at Sun Gate and looked at Machu Picchu from above and cried for no reason I can articulate. It happens.
label: reaction

text: Looked at Booking.com prices vs the hotel direct rate for 8 hotels across 3 countries. Direct rates were equal or lower in 5 cases, higher in 2, and unavailable in 1. The book-direct messaging is real but not universal.
label: analysis

text: Arrived in Havana in the rain with no idea what anything cost, no working phone, and no plan. Three hours later I had all of those things and a new favorite city.
label: reaction
